items.q: Whose turn is it to do the watering this week?

items.answer: Cut back the boundary hedge; Clear the drainage ditch; Return the borrowed rotavator; Renew the public liability insurance

items.q: What does Priya need to do before the committee meeting on Thursday 18 March?
items.answer: Book the skip for the clear-out by Wednesday 17 March (the permit has come through), and send round the AGM minutes by Thursday 18 March (the draft is done).

items.q: Is anything waiting on the council? If so, what?
items.answer: Yes — Wren’s “Fix the main gate lock” is waiting on the Council estates team; Hal’s “Get the water meter replaced” is waiting on the council, with the visit not booked yet; and Ines’s completed “Report the fly-tipping by the gate” is still waiting on the council.

items.q: Who is going to repaint the noticeboard?
items.answer: Nobody yet — the task is unassigned.

items.q: Has the number of manure loads been decided? If so, how many?
items.answer: No, the number of loads is still to be decided at the meeting.
